## Context
The public CLI and Python library support relation-specific unlink so callers can remove exactly one edge when the same ticket pair carries multiple relations. The registered MCP `unlink_tickets` tool accepts only `id1` and `id2` and delegates `rebar.unlink` without `relation`. FastMCP therefore advertises no relation field and execution takes the pair-scoped fallback, removing the most-recent edge rather than the requested edge.

The signed final write-surface ruling on `restoring-shallow-blobfish` requires total parameter parity across library, CLI, and MCP with zero intended divergences. The earlier relation-scoped change explicitly left MCP outside that change scope, but did not establish a permanent divergence.

## Proven root cause
`src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py::unlink_tickets` independently omits the already-supported optional relation selector from (1) its registered callable signature/live FastMCP schema and (2) its `rebar.unlink` delegate call. Runtime experiments proved both omissions: current MCP forwards only two args and removes the newest relation; a signature-only mutation makes the schema accept `relation` but still loses the value at the delegate.

## Repair plan
- Add `relation: str | None = None` to the MCP callable, matching the public library contract.
- Forward `relation` unchanged to `rebar.unlink`.
- Update the tool description to document explicit relation-scoped removal and the omitted-selector fallback.
- Regenerate `docs/mcp-reference.md` from the registered tool contract with `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py`.
- Add a held-out interface oracle through the real FastMCP registration and real ephemeral ticket store.
- Preserve pair-scoped most-recent behavior when `relation` is omitted.
- Complete the five-slot write-surface parity census required by rebar-debug. Repair in this ticket only an identical missing-parameter/missing-forwarding omission on the same unlink operation; file and `discovered_from`-link a separate bug for any different operation, broader behavioral mismatch, or design-dependent gap.

## Test contract card
- authoritative_contract: signed total write-parameter parity ruling on restoring-shallow-blobfish plus relation-scoped unlink contract in docs/user-guide.md, docs/cli-reference.md, and test_unlink_relation_scoped_e39f.py.
- trigger_preconditions: one ordered ticket pair holds `blocks` then `relates_to`; MCP receives `relation="blocks"`.
- production_path: real FastMCP registration/schema -> `unlink_tickets` -> public `rebar.unlink` -> real git-backed ticket store.
- test_tier: interface/lifecycle test; a unit test cannot prove live schema binding and persisted edge selection together.
- observable_postcondition: live schema advertises optional relation; explicit `blocks` removes only blocks and leaves relates_to; omitted relation removes newest relates_to and leaves blocks.
- negative_control: omit relation and verify the existing pair-scoped fallback is unchanged.
- collateral_invariants: the unselected edge and reciprocal relation state remain correct.
- ci_gate: focused interface suite, `python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, make lint, and make typecheck.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] MCP unlink_tickets accepts an optional `relation` parameter.
- [x] The live MCP schema advertises `relation` as optional with the same string-or-null type as the library contract.
- [x] A supplied relation is forwarded unchanged.
- [x] Supplying `blocks` removes only that edge while preserving `relates_to`.
- [x] Omitting relation preserves the documented pair-scoped most-recent fallback.
- [x] The selected interface test is collected and executes without skip/xfail.
- [x] The selected interface test returns to RED when the signature omission is restored.
- [x] The selected interface test returns to RED when the forwarding omission is restored.
- [x] The five-slot parity census records a cited result and disposition for every surface.
- [x] Every confirmed sibling outside the identical unlink-adapter omission is recorded as a separately linked bug.
- [x] Focused MCP/link tests pass.
- [x] The generated MCP reference drift check passes.
- [x] make lint passes.
- [x] make typecheck passes.
